policies.backend:
<set-variable name="clientId" value="@(context.Configuration.GetValueOrDefault("aad-client-id"))" /> <set-variable name="clientSecret" value="@(context.Configuration.GetValueOrDefault("aad-client-secret"))" /> <set-variable name="scope" value="@(context.Configuration.GetValueOrDefault("aad-scope"))" />
@(context.Variables["aadTokenEndpoint"]) POST
application/x-www-form-urlencoded
@($"client_id={System.Net.WebUtility.UrlEncode((string)context.Variables["clientId"])}&client_secret={System.Net.WebUtility.UrlEncode((string)context.Variables["clientSecret"])}&grant_type=urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:jwt-bearer&requested_token_use=on_behalf_of&assertion={System.Net.WebUtility.UrlEncode((string)context.Variables["obo_assertion"])}&scope={System.Net.WebUtility.UrlEncode((string)context.Variables["scope"])}")
<set-variable name="backendAccessToken" value="@(((IResponse)context.Variables["oboTokenResponse"]).Body.As()["access_token"]?.ToString() ?? String.Empty)" />
application/json
{ "status": "error", "severity": "non-recoverable", "category": "auth", "backendStatus": @(context.Variables.ContainsKey("oboTokenResponse") ? ((IResponse)context.Variables["oboTokenResponse"]).StatusCode.ToString() : "null"), "code": "obo_token_acquisition_failed", "message": "Failed to acquire on-behalf-of token from AAD.", "correlationId": "@(context.Variables["correlationId"])", "details": { "tokenResponseBody": @(context.Variables.ContainsKey("oboTokenResponse") ? ((IResponse)context.Variables["oboTokenResponse"]).Body.As() : "null") } }
@($"Bearer {(string)context.Variables["backendAccessToken"]}")
<retry condition="@(context.Response == null || ((int)context.Response.StatusCode >= 500 && (int)context.Response.StatusCode < 600))" count="3" interval="2" delta="2" max-interval="16">

choose.when:
<set-variable name="backendBody" value="@(context.Response.Body.As())" />
application/json
{ "status": "error", "severity": "@(context.Variables["severity"])", "category": "@(context.Variables["category"])", "backendStatus": @(context.Variables["backendStatus"]), "code": "@(context.Variables["code"])", "message": "@( (string.IsNullOrEmpty((string)context.Variables["backendBody"]) ? "Upstream service returned an error." : ((string)context.Variables["backendBody"]).Replace("\n"," ").Replace("\r"," ").Replace("\"","'") ) )", "correlationId": "@(context.Variables["correlationId"])", "details": { "attempts": @(context.Variables.ContainsKey("retry-count") ? context.Variables["retry-count"] : "unknown"), "backendBodySample": @( (string)context.Variables["backendBody"] != null && ((string)context.Variables["backendBody"]).Length < 1000 ? ((string)context.Variables["backendBody"]) : (((string)context.Variables["backendBody"]) != null ? (((string)context.Variables["backendBody"]).Substring(0,1000) + "...") : "" ) ) } }
